name: Feral but FRESH Cream Deodorant
blurb: A rich, scoopable cream deodorant handmade for long-lasting freshness and odor control without aluminum. This buttery formula melts into the skin, spreads easily, and dries down with a smooth, non-greasy feel. Scented with a fresh, earthy blend of lavender, cedarwood, orange, and tea tree. 2 oz amber glass jar.
ingredients: Essential Oils (Lavender, Cedarwood, Orange, Tea Tree)

usageGuide.howToApply: Scoop out a small amount with clean, dry fingers and massage into clean, dry underarms. Start with less than you think you need. You can always add more.
usageGuide.storage: Keep the jar in a cool spot; the butters soften in summer heat and firm back up when cool. Shelf life is 12 months.
usageGuide.patchTest: Baking soda can irritate freshly shaved or sensitive underarms. Try a small amount for a day or two first. Contains essential oils and almond oil.
